title: AI, skills and innovation: How Australia and India’s youth are preparing for the future
description: With Artificial Intelligence and new technologies changing the way we live and work, young people are exploring new ways to learn, adapt and create connections. The Australia India Youth Dialogue 2026 brought together youth from Australia and India to exchange experiences and perspectives on the changing world. In this podcast, we speak with Dr Vipin Das and Aman Gaur about the role of youth, AI, future opportunities and the evolving Australia-India relationship.

title: Testing time : Security, transparency hold the key for NTA
description: THE beleaguered National Testing Agency’s (NTA) decision to invite veterans from intelligence, law enforcement and the defence forces to join its examination security command centre is a welcome step — but it is also a reminder of how vulnerable India’s high-stakes entrance tests have become. The proposed General Manager (Test Security & Live Operations) will oversee virtually every sensitive link in the chain, from question-paper setting and encryption to transportation, storage, distribution and real-time monitoring. Artificial intelligence, biometric authentication, CCTV surveillance and post-examination data analysis are expected to strengthen the system. On paper, this seems to be a serious attempt to rebuild trust after the NEET fiasco.
